system.description:
you count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only when directly opposite.

    • 15th level: +1 AC unless you wield a two-handed weapon, and a Flank Attack also pushes the target 5ft and deals +1 damage die.

rules.when: Flank Attack (you flank whenever an ally is also in melee with the target)

rules.value: Battle Space: {15:a Flank Attack also pushes the target 5ft and deals +1 damage die}.
